M-01.title: 单一事实源写台账
M-01.scenario: 任何代码/测试/浏览器/进程变更

M-02.title: 浏览器验收先分离工具故障与业务回归
M-02.rule: agent-browser ref 失败时，用第二工具或 curl API 交叉验证
M-02.trigger: UI 验收出现 timeout/ref 错误

M-03.title: 关键事实以 DB/命令输出为准
M-03.scenario: 覆盖率、入库条数、IC 指标
M-03.rule: LLM 不做事实源；必须 fresh query / pytest 输出

M-04.title: Web 语料库验收前置 Docker PG
M-04.rule: 先 `docker info`；端口 55432 已占用可能表示 **PG 已在跑** → 用 `curl /api/v1/corpus/libraries/*/coverage` 验证，勿盲目 `docker compose up`
M-04.trigger: Postgres 连接错误 vs 端口 already allocated

M-05.title: 热路径改 import 后立即跑相关单测
M-05.rule: 改完跑 `pytest tests/test_signal_extraction_unit.py -q` 再扩扫
M-05.trigger: 动 N1/N0 信号或 intake 链

M-07.title: PowerShell 链式命令
M-07.rule: 用 `;` 或 `Set-Location` 分行，**不用** `&&`
M-07.source: 轮次-20260619-loop1 · uvicorn 启动失败

M-08.title: U 轨早退须条件化
M-08.rule: 无 URL/文件/carry_over 材料 → `build_understand_reply`；有材料 → 允许 `article_reading` + `insight_extraction_dispatch`，仅阻断因子轨
M-08.trigger: U 轨 + 用户贴链接

M-10.title: 先锁合同再扩页面
M-10.rule: schema YAML + dataclass + 单测 → 再 executor/UI
M-10.trigger: 新 capability 或实验治理

M-11.title: C_COMPARE 路由先于 WR loop
M-11.rule: 在 `web_research_loop` 门禁之前，对 `not executions` 检查 compare/search 目标

M-12.title: Loop 真循环需 Automation 桥接
M-12.scenario: 心流/Loop 协议已写但会话 turn 结束即停
M-12.rule: 跨会话续跑必须：`harness/loop-state.json` + `loop-tick-prompt` +（可选）`schedule.json` loop-tick；单 LLM 会话不能 OS 级自唤醒
M-12.trigger: 用户要求「无需 prompt 无限循环」

M-15.title: Loop 续跑靠 L0 规则 + loop_tick 机器态
M-15.scenario: Markdown Loop 协议跨 turn 失忆、agent 停顿问用户
M-15.trigger: 用户要求无限 Loop / 自派任务

M-16.title: N1 mixed 必须进 input_completeness + secondary_queue
M-16.scenario: batch+公式 / file+URL 混合输入

M-17.title: 方法论微步骤 digest 门控
M-17.rule: 自问是否新增方法论；**无则零写入** METHODOLOGY 但 §5 **须留痕** `方法论门控：M-17 零写入 · 见 METHODOLOGY §轮次-…`；**有则**步骤 digest；关键任务 done 时收口 synthesis → M-xx/GP-xx
M-17.trigger: 所有 Loop tick / worker tick

M-18.title: secondary queue 测 merge 层而非全链路 clarify
M-18.rule: batch_mining clarify 会抢先返回时，patch `_run_quant_trading_loop_impl` 测 merge 层

M-19.title: MiningLoop VALID 未过则 skip L3b
M-19.rule: `run_mining_loop_round` 先 L3a VALID；未通过则 `l3b_skipped`，不调用 L3b runner

M-20.title: Co-STEER 失败归档 + 成功片段注入
M-20.scenario: MINE-5 MiningLoop trial 可观测性 / 代码修复 prompt 增强
M-20.rule: 单轮失败时 `CoSteerTraceStore.archive_failure` + `retrieve` 相似成功 DSL 片段；成功时 `archive_success`；MiningLoop 结果携带 `costeer.prompt_injection`
M-20.trigger: MINE-5+ 多轮挖掘 loop · IMPL 阶段 LLM 修复

M-21.title: API 验收前确认 uvicorn 已加载最新代码
M-21.scenario: PL-C-GEN R0/R1/R2 API 驱动验收
M-21.rule: 代码修复后单测已绿但 API 仍 fail → 先重启 `:8350` uvicorn 再跑验收脚本；勿把 stale 进程当回归
M-21.trigger: loop12 R2-M4 fail → loop13/14 post-restart pass

M-22.title: clarify 续接优先 resumable intent_session
M-22.rule: `resolve_intent_session_for_thread` 优先 `awaiting_checkpoint`+`CLARIFY_WAIT`；`rows_to_ui_messages` 映射 `brain_intent_session`；勿被 latest done brain_run 或 IDLE 消息态覆盖
M-22.trigger: clarify 续接 · brain_run 恢复链

M-23.title: C4 实盘 REJECT 先于 C6 调仓判定
M-23.scenario: R2-M4「帮我做实盘下单」vs「我该调仓吗」
M-23.rule: `intent_conflict` C4 先于 C6；实盘/下单勿标 G outcome；二者 REJECT 文案须 distinct
M-23.trigger: R2 边界验收 · live trading 关键词

M-24.title: MiningLoop VALID 前 AST/IC dedup + negative_kb
M-24.rule: `factor_dedup_gate`（AST Jaccard + IC_max）与 `negative_kb` 接入 VALID 前；全拒则 blocked

M-25.title: 浏览器 QA 前确认 dev 路由已注册
M-25.rule: 跑 agent-browser 对照前确认 `App.tsx` 已注册目标 Route；组件文件存在 ≠ 路由可达
M-25.source: 收口 synthesis-pl-c-ui-a · loop15 并行

M-26.title: /lab v1 只读 snapshot 驱动
M-26.rule: 四 Tab 消费 `GET /api/v1/quant/mining-lab/snapshot`；写/编排仍走 Assistant；无 job 时用 demo 合成面板短 MiningLoop，勿在 UI 层伪造写 API
M-26.trigger: /lab MVP · MINE-7+ 持久化/SSE 接入前

M-27.title: 跨 job intent_session 三层恢复
M-27.scenario: GEN-P0'.1 clarify 续接 · job 完成与 message/DB 落盘之间的刷新窗口
M-27.rule: `resolve_intent_session_for_thread` 顺序 — resumable message → **in-memory completed job**（`recover_intent_session_from_jobs`）→ brain_run checkpoint；`start_chat_brain_job` 须带 `thread_id`/`dsn`；worker 完成时 `_persist_job_brain_run_if_resumable` fail-open 尽早落盘
M-27.trigger: T6 刷新 · SSE `_persist_on_done` 前 POST「继续」

M-28.title: quant-only 前台主线门控
M-28.scenario: 用户战略 pivot 或产品方向收窄
M-28.rule: 前台仅允许 **1 条量化主线**（`PL-C-MINE`）；非量化切片（stock_research · 通用 WR · UI cosmetic · BENCH env · KB browser polish）一律 `parking_lot` 或 **cancelled**；`loop-state.next_atomic_action` 必须指向量化切片；GEN 仅保留 **intent quant 子图** + **corpus_hit 公式**
M-28.trigger: 战略聚焦变更 · 新切片立项前
M-28.source: 步骤 digest-loop42-quant-pivot · loop42 · 用户权威指令 2026-06-19

M-29.title: Co-STEER 轮间 DSL 修复优先于重复失败
M-29.scenario: MINE-5 deepen · 多轮 MiningLoop 失败后的 IMPL 修复链
M-29.rule: 单轮失败 `costeer.prompt_injection` 经 `propose_costeer_dsl_repair` 在**下一轮开始前**更新 `current_dsl_spec`；记录 `costeer_repair` stage 与 `MiningLoopDispatchResultV1.costeer.evolution`；`experiment_graph` mutation/crossover 已改 DSL 时**跳过** costeer 轮间修复；`run_mining_loop` 默认自建 `CoSteerTraceStore`
M-29.trigger: MINE-5+ 多轮挖掘 · `/lab` demo 快照

M-30.title: PL-C-MINE MVP 切片集收口门控
M-30.scenario: PL-C-MINE MINE-0…8 全切片实现完成、待 closure_gate 裁定
M-30.rule: quant-only 下 **代码+pytest 合同**即 MVP slice-set closed；master-plan 跨 Phase 量化验收（IC 对照 · 零人工轮次 · 浏览器 E2E）**不阻塞** gate，但必须显式记入 parking_lot；M-28 已 park 项不得作为 continue 理由
M-30.trigger: MINE 末切片 deepen 完成 · critic|constitution-guardian 双帽裁定

M-31.title: Worker/Skill 用户权威创建门控
M-31.scenario: 编排器识别 worker 过载或重复工作流需 skill 化
M-31.rule: **禁止**自动新建 `agents/*.md` 或 `skills/*/SKILL.md`；须先负载再平衡（idle worker 激活、切片拆分）；仅当职责与现有 21 worker 无模糊重复时，经 **AskQuestion 对话框** 获用户批准后方可创建；过载标记不等于扩容许可
M-31.trigger: `executor` / `qa-tester` / `governance-coordinator` 连续多 tick 过载 · `$skillify` / 方法论沉淀识别 ≥3 次重复流程

M-32.title: TREE-2 数据 gap 闭合三件套
M-32.scenario: DATA_RELIABILITY_CHARTER blocker 项 backfill 长跑收尾
M-32.rule: `remaining=0` + `save_status_snapshot` + gap list 标 **complete** 三件套齐备方可声称 blocker 闭合；bounded tick 禁止无限长跑（loop64–74 模式）
M-32.trigger: index_weight / 月切片 / 任何 watermark 驱动 backfill

M-33.title: Loop 目标包络与连续同族上限
M-33.scenario: CodeX loop 在同一 PL / surface / source-contract 上连续追加 marker、checklist、ledger、banner、risk/register/handoff 等命名差异小切片
M-33.rule: `next_atomic_action` 必须“小到可验证，大到关闭一个目标验收点”；同一 `slice_family` 连续 ≥3 tick 时，下一轮必须改为 `goal_bundle` / reviewer-verifier signoff / 真实集成晋级 / 路由到下一 goal；禁止继续第 4 个同族 mocked/source-contract 微切片，除非 §5 明确记录其为高风险探针、环境阻塞探针或破坏性操作预检
M-33.trigger: PL-G route-evidence acceptance loop190–201 类连续 mocked/source/UI contract 切片；任意 loop 出现同族最新 3 条 §5 台账

M-34.title: CodeX worker cluster 汇合门禁
M-34.scenario: 用户要求 orchestrator 真正统筹跨对话 workers，而不是自己承担实现/测试/审查/治理；或目标包络包含多文件、多角色、外部研究、review/signoff 任一复杂度
M-34.rule: 先写 `goal_envelope`，再写 `cluster_manifest`，用现有 roster role 建立跨对话 worker cluster；worker 只按 disjoint scope 工作并返回 report；`rendezvous_gate` 要求 required reports 到齐或 blocker 留痕后，orchestrator 才能复核、验证、更新 roster/§5 并声称完成
M-34.trigger: 任意 `goal_bundle`、多 worker 调度、外部架构研究、计划/实现/测试/审查/verification 分离任务

M-35.title: Acceptance bundle 语义证据绑定
M-35.scenario: route-evidence / readiness / acceptance bundle 声称已合并 reviewer signoff、source/UI contract audit、safety gate、handoff packet、exit/next-route decision 等目标包络
M-35.rule: 每个“decision / exit / next route / safety gate”类 marker 必须绑定到真实 source/UI/runtime evidence marker（如 `pageMarker`、contract source、response/refreshed text），不能只把声明写成 check name；reviewer 找到语义缺口后先补 RED，再让实现绑定证据并由 verifier 复核
M-35.trigger: 任何连续多轮 mocked/source/UI acceptance 链、goal bundle、operator handoff、route decision 或阶段收口声明

M-36.title: Route transition evidence demotes the old active route
M-36.scenario: 一个验收链从旧 route / phase / intent 进入新的真实流程 readiness，例如从 `pl_g_flow_hardening` 进入 `intent_quant_integration_readiness` / `auto_backtest_flow_readiness`
M-36.rule: 旧 active route 不得继续作为 `next_route=*` 出现；必须降级为 `previous_route=*` / `from_route=*` / transition marker，并让新 active routes 同时出现在 source contract、UI body text、smoke text checks 与 stale-marker guard 中
M-36.trigger: 任何 route guidance、next action、handoff、state-machine transition、readiness gate 或 intent subgraph handoff

M-37.title: Readiness handoff bundle binds three runtime surfaces
M-37.scenario: route guidance transition 已完成，下一步要把 intent quant readiness 与 auto mining -> auto backtest handoff surface 连接起来
M-37.rule: readiness handoff bundle 必须同时绑定三面证据：body route guidance（previous/transition/active next routes）、submitted explicit-trigger route evidence（flow/stage/handoff source）和 refreshed Jobs route evidence（同一 flow/stage/handoff source + PL-H deferred）。不得把该 bundle 退化为新的 acceptance/checklist family。
M-37.trigger: intent quant subgraph readiness、auto mining -> auto backtest handoff、Jobs route evidence refresh、real-batch demand gate review 前置

M-38.title: Demand-gate review proves evidence, not execution permission
M-38.scenario: auto mining -> auto backtest 已有 readiness handoff，下一步要评估 observability chain 与 real-batch demand gate readiness
M-38.rule: demand-gate review 只能证明证据链与风险门槛已被 source/UI/runtime markers 绑定；不得把 `review_required`、`requires_injected_runner`、`PL-H deferred` 等审查结果写成 runner enabled、batch execution ready 或默认真实 DB-backed backtest。下一步必须转入 explicit approval / runner readiness / PL-H eligibility preflight，而不是直接执行。
M-38.trigger: real-batch demand gate、explicit runner、PL-H eligibility、default DB-backed backtest、manual trigger escalation、operator approval handoff

M-39.title: Preflight readiness proves negative authorization state
M-39.scenario: demand-gate review 之后，系统需要进入 explicit approval / runner readiness / PL-H eligibility preflight，但真实 runner、default DB-backed backtest、PL-H batch execution 仍未获授权
M-39.rule: preflight bundle 的正确信号是 `required_not_granted`、`injected_runner_required_not_connected`、`not_eligible_until_real_batch_gate` 这类负向 readiness；它必须证明“还不能执行”的原因、所需下一 gate 与安全禁区，而不是把 preflight 命名成 approval accepted、runner enabled 或 PL-H eligible。
M-39.trigger: manual trigger escalation、runner wiring demand/authorization gate、live batch execution、migration/backfill/DB-backed side effects、PL-H eligibility review

M-40.title: Runner wiring requires an authorization planning gate before implementation
M-40.scenario: preflight 已证明 approval not granted / runner not connected / PL-H not eligible，下一步需要靠近真实 runner wiring、injected runner config、rollback/audit 与 PL-H eligibility 复核
M-40.rule: runner wiring 前一拍必须先形成 planning-only gate artifact，同时覆盖四件事：explicit authorization contract、injected-runner configuration boundary、rollback/observability requirements、PL-H non-eligibility guard。该 artifact 的成功条件仍是“未来接线必须满足什么”，不是“现在可以接线”；enabled/eligible/granted 语义只能作为 forbidden markers 或后续显式 gate 的输入。
M-40.trigger: 真实 runner 接线、manual authorization artifact、fail-closed runner implementation plan、batch execution gate、PL-H eligibility recheck、任何默认 runner / background process / DB-backed side-effect 之前

M-41.title: Implementation preflight proves fail-closed wiring before any runner call
M-41.scenario: authorization planning gate 已完成，下一步要进入 explicit runner wiring design/implementation preflight，但真实/default runner、manual authorization artifact、rollback/audit hooks 与 PL-H eligibility 仍未落地
M-41.rule: implementation preflight 的成功条件不是“开始接线”，而是证明 no-default-runner injected-runner-only design contract、explicit authorization inputs、rollback/audit evidence、fail-closed missing-runner boundary 与 PL-H non-eligibility recheck 已被同一证据链锁定。任何 `runner_enabled`、`authorization_granted`、`execution_started`、`pl_h_eligible` 语义只能出现在 forbidden markers 或后续显式 gate 中。
M-41.trigger: manual authorization artifact、fail-closed injected-runner implementation plan、external runner adapter、batch execution gate、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H eligibility recheck 之前

M-42.title: Manual authorization artifact is fail-closed evidence, not execution permission
M-42.scenario: implementation preflight 已证明 no-default-runner / injected-runner-only / fail-closed wiring，但要进入 manual authorization artifact、call boundary、rollback/observability contract 或真实 runner adapter 前
M-42.rule: manual authorization artifact 的成功条件不是“授权已授予”，而是同时证明 injected-runner-only artifact present、default runner disabled、rollback/audit hooks required、missing runner fail-closed、PL-H non-eligible until later gate。任何 `authorization_granted`、`runner_enabled`、`execution_started`、`pl_h_eligible`、`default_runner` 语义只能作为 forbidden markers 或负向 guard 出现。
M-42.trigger: explicit runner call boundary、authorized runner injection test seam、external executor handoff、default runner fallback、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H batch execution re-evaluation 之前

M-43.title: Call boundary / rollback-observability contract is not runner invocation
M-43.scenario: manual authorization artifact 已存在，系统准备定义 injected-runner call boundary、rollback/observability、audit before/after 或 PL-H eligibility recheck，但仍未进入真实 runner adapter / real batch execution
M-43.rule: call boundary contract 的成功条件是证明 explicit authorization handoff required、rollback observability required before call、audit events required before/after call、missing runner fail-closed、PL-H non-eligible until authorized real-batch gate；它不是 `runner_call_started`、不是 `authorization_granted`、不是 `runner_enabled`、也不是 PL-H eligibility。任何 enabled/granted/started/eligible 语义必须只出现在 forbidden markers 或负向 guard 中。
M-43.trigger: authorized runner injection seam、real runner adapter dry-run、external executor handoff、scheduler/background worker、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H batch execution re-evaluation 之前

M-44.title: Authorized runner injection seam proves shape and gates, not authorization or invocation
M-44.scenario: call boundary / rollback-observability contract 已存在，系统准备表达 authorized runner injection seam、authorization token/input shape、adapter boundary 或 PL-H eligibility recheck，但仍未进入 real runner adapter / production runner invocation
M-44.rule: authorized runner injection seam 的成功条件是证明 opaque operator token required/not persisted、required input shape、explicit parameter-only adapter boundary、rollback/audit proof、PL-H not eligible until authorized real-batch gate，以及所有 forbidden active enablement markers 仍只出现在负向 guard 中。`authorized` 在这里是 seam 名称与输入形态，不是 authorization granted、runner enabled、runner call started 或 PL-H eligible。
M-44.trigger: real runner adapter dry-run、external executor handoff、scheduler/background worker、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H batch execution gate 之前

M-45.title: Real-runner adapter dry-run planning proves contract boundaries, not dry-run execution
M-45.scenario: authorized runner injection seam 已存在，系统准备描述 real-runner adapter dry-run、PL-H eligibility gate、adapter contract review、authorization evidence handoff 或 rollback/audit proof，但还没有进入真实 runner/default runner、真实 dry-run execution、background worker、DB-backed backtest 或 PL-H batch execution。
M-45.rule: real-runner adapter dry-run planning 的成功条件是证明 adapter contract review required、authorization evidence handoff required、rollback/audit gates required、explicit runner config required、PL-H eligibility fail-closed/not eligible，以及所有 invocation/started/enabled/granted/eligible markers 仅作为 forbidden markers 或 negative guards。`dry-run` 在这里表示 proof/planning harness，不是 adapter call started、runner dry-run started 或 execution permission granted。
M-45.trigger: adapter contract review / dry-run proof harness、runner readiness matrix、external executor injection、scheduler/background worker、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H batch execution gate 之前

M-46.title: Adapter contract review proof harness is review evidence, not execution readiness
M-46.scenario: adapter dry-run planning gate 已存在，系统准备表达 explicit adapter contract review、dry-run proof harness、authorization evidence validation、rollback/audit before-after proof、runner config requirement 或 PL-H decision review，但仍未进入真实 adapter call、runner dry-run execution、background worker、DB-backed backtest 或 PL-H batch execution。
M-46.rule: contract review / proof harness 的成功条件是证明 contract review only、mocked proof only not execution、authorization evidence validation required、rollback/audit before-after proof required、explicit runner config required/no default lookup、PL-H fail-closed/not eligible，以及所有 approved/invoked/started/enabled/eligible markers 仅作为 forbidden markers 或 negative guards。不能把 review/proof/check 名称当成授权、执行 readiness 或 adapter call 证据。
M-46.trigger: dry-run proof review gate、runner-adapter readiness matrix、external executor injection、scheduler/background worker、DB-backed backtest promotion、PL-H batch execution gate 之前

GP-01.title: Loop 工作汇报与索引分离
GP-01.rule: 实现写 §5；orchestrator + worker 报告写 `harness/reports/`；`work_report_lifecycle.py` 维护机器索引，避免 §5 膨胀
GP-01.trigger: ≥3 并行 worker 或 loop tick

GP-02.title: 方法论分层写入（digest → synthesis → permanent）
GP-02.scenario: 长期自治 Loop 项目
GP-02.rule: 微步骤 digest 门控 → 任务收口 synthesis → M-xx/GP-xx 永久库；避免每步写完整复盘
GP-02.trigger: Loop Engineering / Ralph Loop 类项目

GP-03.title: 每轮 lifecycle 与 §5 台账同级
GP-03.scenario: Loop Engineering / 多 worker 自治 Harness
GP-03.rule: 每原子任务收工 **必跑** `methodology_memory_lifecycle.py run --apply` + `work_report_lifecycle.py run --apply`；`loop_tick.py prepare/advance` subprocess 桥接；失败写 `loop-lifecycle-errors.log`（fail-closed 可见，不阻断 loop）；禁止 `--dry-run` 替代或等用户提醒
GP-03.trigger: orchestrator tick · worker 回填 · compliance MEM-004（`last_lifecycle.at` ≤24h）

GP-04.title: 五真源同步 + 三治理 lifecycle
GP-04.scenario: Loop tick 后 prose 真源与机器索引漂移
GP-04.rule: 每原子任务除 §5 外 **必更新** `PROJECT_STATUS.md` 顶部「心流模式当前轮」现状概述（1–3 句）；每 tick **必跑** `sync_coherence_lifecycle` + `verification_snapshot_lifecycle` + `closure_gate_lifecycle`（`run --apply`）；`sync_coherence` 只读校验、不自动改 prose；验证后 `verification_snapshot record`
GP-04.trigger: orchestrator/worker 收工 · `loop_tick prepare/advance` · compliance SYNC/VER/CLO

GP-05.title: Worker/Skill 治理审计与 AskQuestion 扩容
GP-05.scenario: 21 worker 负载不均 · skills 镜像漂移 · 重复工作流未 skill 化
GP-05.rule: 每轮或方法论沉淀时轻量审计 `harness/reports/workers/` 与 `skills/`↔`.trae/skills/`；过载先再平衡 **不自动新建 worker**；新建 worker/skill **必须** AskQuestion 用户对话框（「是否将…职责变为新 worker …?」「是否将…工作流集成为 skill …?」）；提案须附与最近邻角色差异矩阵；仅追加治理文档，不改 harness/loop-state/CONSTITUTION 稳固架构
GP-05.trigger: orchestrator tick · governance-coordinator 健康检查 · `$skillify` 候选识别

GP-06.title: 零配置项目适配器
GP-06.scenario: 刚安装/刚注册的 CodeX 或其他编码代理，需要仅凭起始 Prompt 接手任意正在进行或初始化的软件项目
GP-06.rule: 把 Harness 最小核心收口为“项目内真源 + 起始 Prompt + subagent report 合同 + 单命令适配器”；适配器只生成缺失文件，绝不复制秘密，绝不覆盖已有重要文件，冲突候选写入 `.awi-adapter/proposed/` 并输出机器报告
GP-06.trigger: 跨项目引入 AWI / Loop / Harness Engineering，而目标项目缺少完整 raindeer 上下文

GP-07.title: 员工清单调度索引
GP-07.scenario: 跨聊天 subagents / workers 数量增长后，总调度需要在不依赖聊天记忆的情况下选择、追踪和复盘 worker
GP-07.rule: 把 worker 事实分成两层：`harness/reports/workers/*.md` 保存详细工作报告，`harness/reports/EMPLOYEE_ROSTER.md` 保存可调度索引（identity、职责边界、report 路径、状态、负载、错误/教训计数、当前任务、升级规则）；派工前读 roster，report 回来后由总调度回写 roster
GP-07.trigger: 任意项目使用 AWI / CodeX zero-config 进行跨聊天 worker 派工

GP-08.title: Git main-only 双仓库开发
GP-08.scenario: AWI 根 + quant_assistant 双仓库日常开发与 `daily-git-push` Automation
GP-08.rule: 两仓库本地分支 **MUST** 为 `main`；禁止 `cursor/*`、`feat/*` 等作为日常工作区；AWI 本地 `main` 跟踪 `origin/raindeer-AWI` 合法；quant 本地 `main` 跟踪 `origin/main`；`daily-git-push.ps1` 检测非 main → **blocked** exit 1；脚本/代理 **不得** 自动删除用户遗留分支
GP-08.trigger: Loop tick git 快照 · 日末 push · CodeX/orchestrator 接手任意仓库
GP-08.source: 步骤 digest-20260621-git-main-only · 用户权威 policy · §5.446

GP-09.title: Skill/Worker/Goal 前置路由门禁
GP-09.scenario: 大型项目 skills 很多但实际调用率低、worker roster 很完整但派工少、orchestrator 连续自做实现/测试/审查/治理，或 loop 滑向低价值连续小切片
GP-09.rule: 每轮执行前强制四门：Goal/Plan Gate 记录 `goal_id/slice_family/acceptance_gate/exit_to_real_flow`；Skill Routing Gate 运行 router 并记录 `selected_skills/applied_skills/skipped_skills/no_skill_reason/skill_lifecycle`；Worker Dispatch Gate 记录 `dispatch_decision/no_dispatch_reason/capacity_review`；Worker Cluster Gate 记录 `cluster_manifest/worker_report_refs/rendezvous_gate`，优先跨对话 worker，触发条件下 fail-closed 到派工或真实 blocker
GP-09.trigger: 任意 CodeX heartbeat / orchestrator loop tick；2+ 独立切片、多文件实现、计划/代码/QA/security/governance/verification 任一工作；同类流程重复 ≥3 次

GP-10.title: Goal-envelope worker cluster
GP-10.scenario: 长期自治项目需要 main agent 管理多个 worker/subagent，且上下文、职责、审计、验证不能混在同一对话里
GP-10.rule: 把复杂目标转换为 `goal_envelope -> cluster_manifest -> rendezvous_gate -> verification -> truth_sync`；主调度只做 command/control/integration，不把 worker 中间记录混入主上下文；跨对话 worker 用 role 名 + report contract + roster 映射；hooks/automations 只能辅助提醒和轻量拦截，不能替代权限/验证门禁
GP-10.trigger: CodeX / Kimi Code / Harness 类多代理协作；任意需要跨会话 worker、skill routing、生命周期审计的项目

GP-11.title: Semantic check names need evidence anchors
GP-11.scenario: 测试或 smoke fixture 用字符串 marker 表达高层验收语义
GP-11.rule: 高层语义 marker 只做可读输出；通过条件必须另有可审计 evidence anchor，例如 source contract marker、body text marker、API payload field、runtime counter 或 explicit forbidden-marker guard

GP-12.title: Route transitions require previous/current split
GP-12.scenario: 任务从一个已验收阶段转入下一阶段，而旧阶段名仍容易被测试/文案误当成 active next route
GP-12.rule: 新阶段 active marker 必须使用 `next_route` / `current_route` / `readiness_route`；旧阶段只能用 `previous_route` / `from_route` / `transition_from`。验证必须包含 stale active marker scan，证明旧 route 没有继续以 active key 存在。
GP-12.trigger: Loop next_atomic_action、Jobs/Chat route guidance、state-machine transition、intent quant subgraph handoff、auto mining -> auto backtest handoff

GP-13.title: Handoff readiness needs cross-surface evidence binding
GP-13.scenario: 一个阶段把 “readiness” 交给下一阶段，尤其是 UI/source-contract mocked smoke 与 runtime evidence 同时存在时
GP-13.rule: readiness handoff 不能只检查一个新可见字符串；必须证明源页面/提交响应/刷新后状态三处围绕同一 flow、stage、handoff source 和 safety deferral 一致。若只是命名变化而无 cross-surface binding，应退回 test design。
GP-13.trigger: multi-surface UI smoke、trigger response refresh、workflow handoff、state-machine readiness、real-batch demand gate preflight

GP-14.title: Gate review and execution enablement must be separate artifacts
GP-14.scenario: 系统从 mocked/source/UI readiness 进入真实执行、批量执行、runner wiring 或外部副作用之前
GP-14.rule: gate review artifact 必须输出 `review_required` / `explicit_runner_required` / `deferred_until_later_gate` / `next_preflight` 等不可执行 markers；execution enablement artifact 必须另有 explicit approval、runner readiness、eligibility 和 rollback/observability checks。二者不能合并为一个“已准备执行”的 marker。
GP-14.trigger: manual trigger、batch execution、workflow promotion、deployment gate、migration gate、data backfill gate、payment/live-trading 等有副作用场景

GP-15.title: Preflight artifacts should encode blockers before permissions
GP-15.scenario: 任何系统在真实副作用前新增 approval/readiness/eligibility preflight
GP-15.rule: 先用显式负向状态记录缺失条件（approval not granted、runner not connected、eligibility deferred、rollback/observability still required），再把下一 gate 命名为授权/接线/回滚/观测设计；禁止在同一个 preflight 里输出 enabled/eligible/ready-to-run 语义。
GP-15.trigger: runner wiring、batch job launch、schema migration、data backfill、production deploy、payment/live trading、外部 API 写操作

GP-16.title: Side-effect implementation needs a four-axis planning gate
GP-16.scenario: 任何系统准备从 mocked/preflight 走向真实 runner、job launcher、migration、batch processor、payment/live trading 或外部写操作
GP-16.rule: 实现前先要求四轴 planning gate：authorization contract、injected/external executor boundary、rollback+observability requirement、eligibility/non-eligibility guard。该 gate 必须由测试和审查证明“尚未启用真实副作用”；只有下一显式 implementation gate 才能消化授权输入。
GP-16.trigger: default runner risk、background process risk、DB-backed execution risk、batch eligibility risk、secret/credential output risk、跨 worker shared-file implementation

GP-17.title: Implementation preflight must prove disabled defaults and fail-closed boundaries
GP-17.scenario: 系统从 planning artifact 进入 implementation preflight，但真实副作用、外部 runner、DB-backed execution、batch eligibility 或 credential-bearing configuration 尚未获授权
GP-17.rule: implementation preflight 必须同时证明 injected/external executor 由调用方显式提供、default executor disabled、missing executor fail-closed、authorization inputs explicit、rollback/audit evidence required before call、batch/eligibility still deferred。验证应扫描 enabled/granted/started/eligible 语义只存在于 guard/forbidden markers，不能作为 active evidence。
GP-17.trigger: runner wiring、job launcher adapter、migration/backfill executor、payment/live-trading executor、production batch processor、任何由 mocked/preflight 转向 implementation 的副作用边界

GP-18.title: Authorization artifacts must be negative contracts before call boundaries
GP-18.scenario: 系统从 preflight / planning evidence 进入 call boundary 或 executor handoff，且真实副作用仍需人工授权、外部配置、rollback/audit 或 eligibility gate
GP-18.rule: 先把 authorization artifact 建成负向可执行合同：artifact required/present、default executor disabled、rollback/audit required、missing executor fail-closed、eligibility still deferred。测试必须禁止 granted/enabled/started/eligible 语义从 forbidden markers 外逸。
GP-18.trigger: runner call boundary、deployment executor、migration executor、payment/live-trading executor、scheduler/background worker、任何会从 artifact 走向真实副作用的接口

GP-19.title: Side-effect call boundaries require rollback, audit, fail-closed, and eligibility proof before invocation
GP-19.scenario: 系统即将把 mocked/planning/source contract 推进到真实 side-effect boundary、external executor seam、job launcher adapter、DB-backed runner、scheduler/background worker、deployment/payment/live trading executor
GP-19.rule: 在任何 invocation 之前，必须用可验证 contract 同时证明 explicit authorization handoff、injected/external executor input shape、rollback/observability proof、audit events before/after、missing executor fail-closed、eligibility recheck gate，并扫描 forbidden active enablement markers。不能把 boundary/helper/check 名称本身当作授权或执行证据。
GP-19.trigger: real runner adapter dry-run、authorized runner injection seam、migration/backfill executor、default executor fallback、PL-H batch execution gate、任何会产生外部副作用的 call boundary

GP-20.title: Authorization-shaped seams require non-persistence, explicit input shape, and negative enablement scans
GP-20.scenario: 任何任务把 authorization/token/user approval/operator handoff、external executor injection、adapter dry-run、scheduler runner 或 DB-backed side-effect boundary 写成 contract/test seam
GP-20.rule: 必须同时证明 token 或 approval evidence 是 required/opaque/not persisted，input shape 显式且不从默认 runner lookup，rollback/audit gates 在调用前可观测，eligibility gate 仍为 not eligible/deferred，且 active enablement/started/eligible/granted markers 经扫描不存在。不能把 authorized/ready/gate/check 名称本身当成授权或执行证据。
GP-20.trigger: real runner adapter dry-run planning、authorized executor injection、migration/backfill executor、default executor fallback、PL-H batch execution gate、任何会产生外部副作用的 authorization-shaped seam

GP-21.title: Adapter dry-run gates require explicit proof harnesses and negative execution scans
GP-21.scenario: 任何任务把 adapter dry-run、runner readiness、authorization evidence、rollback/audit proof、PL-H eligibility 或 external executor handoff 写成合同、测试 seam、proof harness 或 UI/source evidence。
GP-21.rule: 必须同时证明 explicit adapter contract、authorization evidence validation、rollback/audit before-after proof、explicit runner config、不从 default lookup 取 runner、eligibility fail-closed，以及 active execution markers 扫描通过。不能因为出现 dry-run/ready/authorized/eligible 名称，就把 planning/proof gate 解释为真实调用、授权放行或 PL-H 可执行。
GP-21.trigger: real/default runner invocation、adapter dry-run execution、DB-backed backtest、background scheduler、migration/backfill executor、PL-H batch execution、任何会产生外部副作用的 runner adapter gate

GP-22.title: Oversized proof fixtures must be modularized before further marker growth
GP-22.scenario: 单个 smoke fixture / source contract / test file 已承载多轮 proof/check matrices，且继续追加 marker 会让任务退化为微切片堆叠。
GP-22.rule: 当 proof fixture 超过约 3000 pure LOC，下一安全切片应先把同族 proof/check matrices 抽成 bounded module / shared helper，并用 focused tests 保持现有 behavior，再继续新的 readiness matrix。否则会降低 skill/worker 调度价值，增加同族切片漂移和审查成本。
GP-22.trigger: UI smoke fixture、browser harness、contract test、approval/readiness/runner-adapter proof matrices 连续增长；任意同文件连续多轮 marker-only 扩展
